Kids.title: Cars
Kids.description: A talented young race car discovers that true success comes through friendship, humility, and helping others while experiencing an unforgettable journey beyond the racetrack and fame.

Kids.title: Coco
Kids.description: A music-loving boy enters a magical world filled with unforgettable adventures, discovering the importance of family, memories, and following his dreams with courage and determination.

Kids.title: Finding Dory
Kids.description: Dory begins an emotional journey across the ocean to uncover her past, finding friendship, family, and courage while overcoming every challenge that comes her way together.

Kids.title: The Grinch
Kids.description: A grumpy but lonely creature plans to steal Christmas, only to discover that kindness, friendship, and the true holiday spirit can transform even the coldest heart.

Kids.title: Luca
Kids.description: A curious sea monster explores the beautiful Italian coast with his best friend, discovering freedom, friendship, and the courage to embrace who he truly is every day.

Kids.title: Minions
Kids.description: The lovable yellow Minions set out on a hilarious adventure packed with unexpected challenges, unforgettable friendships, and endless laughter while searching for the perfect leader together.

Kids.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
Kids.description: Young Gru joins forces with his loyal Minions in an exciting adventure where bravery, teamwork, and clever ideas help them overcome powerful enemies and impossible situations together.

Kids.title: Minions 3
Kids.description: The mischievous Minions return for another action-packed adventure filled with laughter, surprising friendships, daring missions, and unforgettable moments that keep everyone smiling from start to finish.

Kids.title: Finding Nemo
Kids.description: A devoted father crosses the vast ocean on an unforgettable adventure, discovering courage, friendship, and hope while searching for the son he loves more than anything.

Kids.title: Puss in Boots
Kids.description: The fearless and charming Puss in Boots embarks on another legendary adventure filled with daring escapes, clever plans, loyal friends, and unforgettable moments of bravery and humor.

Kids.title: Toy Story
Kids.description: A group of beloved toys comes to life whenever humans are away, sharing unforgettable adventures that celebrate friendship, loyalty, courage, and the joy of growing together.

Kids.title: Toy Story 2
Kids.description: Woody and his loyal friends set out on another exciting rescue mission, discovering that friendship, trust, and staying together matter more than anything else in life.

Kids.title: Toy Story 3
Kids.description: As their owner prepares for a new chapter, the beloved toys face unexpected adventures that strengthen their friendship and remind them of the importance of never giving up.

Kids.title: Toy Story 4
Kids.description: Woody begins a heartfelt new adventure that challenges his purpose, leading to unforgettable discoveries about friendship, loyalty, freedom, and embracing the future with confidence and hope.
